A.question: Does original XV Legislature deputy index carry a deterministic institutional source ID that can replace exact-name match between voter rows and current Congress roster?
A.estimand: share of indexed profile hyperlinks with unique documented codParlamentario; not real-person scoring
A.known_limits: profile ID may only be stable within one legislature; roster has no explicit ID

B.H1: indexed deputy profile URLs expose non-repeating source-scoped codParlamentario IDs
B.H0: profile URLs contain no stable numerical ID or collide
B.H_other: IDs exist but index is incomplete or dynamically inaccessible

C.instrument: official Congress XV source index + one official profile HTML; strict verified HTTPS; HTMLParser; public links only
C.budget: one index HTML <=3MB, one profile page <=2MB
C.falsifier: zero/duplicate numeric IDs or profile ID not echoed
C.controls: official roster current+discharged schema 412 rows as non-equal reference; no name resolution accepted
C.holdout: all discovery EXPLORATORY; no confirmatory holdout
C.expected: count link IDs and verify ID URL echo

D.success: at least one unique institutional profile ID and valid page link; no identity claim
D.failure: STOP_R5 for identity schema if no link ID

E.before_request: prereg commit; GitHub Actions real source fetch

F.adversarial: publisher page can embed numeric seat order only; name is not ID; link may change

I.validity: source schema test only, not causal, independent person identity or legal party

J.pending: choose C02 only once source structure and CI evidence seen

prereg_timestamp: Git commit datetime, see immutable commit
